design_notes: Expanded all seven locked topics into atomic concepts. Topic 1 has 14 historical/unit concepts because named contributors and SI quantities are tested separately; topics 2-7 range 9-14 depending on calculation/lab density. Historical contributions are separated from calculation concepts to avoid duplication. No topic left thin; no out-of-scope leakage.

topics.title: Electrical quantities, units, and historical foundations

concepts.title: Electric charge and coulomb
concepts.description: Define electric charge as a fundamental quantity and state its SI unit coulomb; distinguish charge amount from current.

concepts.title: Electric current and ampere
concepts.description: Define current as rate of charge flow, state ampere as coulomb/second, and use prefixes mA, µA, and kA.

concepts.title: Electric potential difference and volt
concepts.description: Define voltage as energy per unit charge, state volt as joule/coulomb, and identify common voltage values.

concepts.title: Electrical resistance and ohm
concepts.description: Define resistance as opposition to charge flow and state ohm as volt per ampere; associate resistance with material properties.

concepts.title: Electric power and watt
concepts.description: Define electric power as rate of energy transfer, state the watt as joule/second, and identify common power ratings in watts and milliwatts.

concepts.title: Electrical energy and joule/kilowatt-hour
concepts.description: Define electrical energy as power times time, state joule and kilowatt-hour, and convert between them.

concepts.title: SI prefixes and unit conversion
concepts.description: Convert among common prefixes pico, nano, micro, milli, kilo, mega, and giga used with circuit quantities.

concepts.title: Volta and the voltaic pile
concepts.description: Identify Volta's invention of the voltaic pile as the first continuous electric source and its role in early circuit experiments.

concepts.title: Ohm and the discovery of resistance proportionality
concepts.description: Recognize Georg Ohm's contribution linking current, voltage, and resistance; associate his name with the ohm unit without solving circuit values here.

concepts.title: Kirchhoff and circuit laws
concepts.description: Identify Kirchhoff's current and voltage laws as conservation principles for circuit junctions and loops; associate them with his name.

concepts.title: Coulomb and the torsion balance
concepts.description: Recognize Coulomb's torsion balance measurement of electrostatic force and the naming of the coulomb.

concepts.title: Ampère and electromagnetism
concepts.description: Recognize André-Marie Ampère's work on current-carrying conductors and the naming of the ampere.

concepts.title: Hertz and electromagnetic waves
concepts.description: Identify Hertz's experimental confirmation of electromagnetic waves; associate hertz with frequency.

concepts.title: Boole and Boolean algebra
concepts.description: Recognize George Boole's creation of Boolean algebra as the logical foundation used in digital circuit design.

concepts.title: Conservation of electric charge
concepts.description: State that net charge is conserved in charging and discharge processes; identify electron transfer as the mechanism.

concepts.title: Conductors vs insulators
concepts.description: Distinguish conductors and insulators by electron mobility and give examples used in circuit lab.

concepts.title: Charging by friction
concepts.description: Explain charge transfer by rubbing dissimilar materials and predict resulting signs using the triboelectric series.

concepts.title: Charging by conduction
concepts.description: Explain charging a neutral conductor by touching it with a charged object; predict final charge sharing.

concepts.title: Charging by induction
concepts.description: Explain charging a conductor by induction with grounding and no direct charge transfer; distinguish induction from conduction.

concepts.title: Coulomb's law
concepts.description: Calculate electrostatic force using F = k|q1q2|/r² and determine direction between point charges.

concepts.title: Electric field definition and units
concepts.description: Define electric field as force per unit charge, state units N/C or V/m, and calculate the field of a point charge.

concepts.title: Electric field lines
concepts.description: Interpret and draw electric field lines for point charges, dipoles, and parallel plates; use line density and direction.

concepts.title: Static discharge and grounding
concepts.description: Explain electrostatic discharge, sparks, and the role of grounding in preventing static buildup.

concepts.title: Polarization and induced charge
concepts.description: Distinguish polarization of insulators from induction in conductors; explain attraction of neutral objects by charged objects.

topics.title: DC and AC characteristics, sources, and hazards

concepts.title: Direct current characteristics
concepts.description: Identify DC as unidirectional charge flow, typical sources such as batteries and DC power supplies, and polarity markings.

concepts.title: Alternating current characteristics
concepts.description: Identify AC as periodically reversing charge flow; describe sinusoidal waveform and typical wall outlet values.

concepts.title: AC waveform parameters: peak, RMS, frequency, period
concepts.description: Calculate RMS from peak using V_rms = V_peak/√2, identify frequency and period for sinusoidal AC.

concepts.title: DC and AC voltage sources
concepts.description: Compare battery and wall-outlet/power supply characteristics: voltage, current capacity, polarity, and safety.

concepts.title: Electric shock hazards
concepts.description: Explain shock severity in terms of current through body, voltage, skin resistance, and current path; identify lethal thresholds.

concepts.title: Overload, short circuit, and fire hazards
concepts.description: Explain how excessive current causes heating and fire; distinguish overload and short circuit conditions.

concepts.title: Fuses and circuit breakers
concepts.description: Describe operation of fuses and circuit breakers as overcurrent protection devices and interpret their ratings.

concepts.title: Grounding and equipment safety
concepts.description: Explain protective earthing/grounding, ground-fault paths, and three-prong plug safety.

concepts.title: Common DC and AC applications
concepts.description: Match typical devices and lab equipment to DC or AC power and justify the selection.

topics.title: DC circuits, Ohm's law, and Kirchhoff's laws

concepts.title: Schematic symbols and circuit diagrams
concepts.description: Interpret and draw standard symbols for resistors, batteries, wires, switches, lamps, and meters; trace loops and nodes.

concepts.title: Ohm's law calculations
concepts.description: Use V=IR to solve for voltage, current, or resistance in a single resistive element or simple circuit.

concepts.title: Series circuits
concepts.description: Analyze series resistors: same current, voltage division, total resistance R_total=R1+R2+..., and power additivity.

concepts.title: Parallel circuits
concepts.description: Analyze parallel resistors: same voltage, current division, reciprocal total resistance 1/R_total=1/R1+1/R2+...

concepts.title: Equivalent resistance of resistor networks
concepts.description: Reduce series and parallel combinations stepwise to find the equivalent resistance seen by a source.

concepts.title: Kirchhoff's current law (KCL)
concepts.description: Apply KCL at junctions: sum of currents entering equals sum leaving; solve for unknown branch currents.

concepts.title: Kirchhoff's voltage law (KVL)
concepts.description: Apply KVL around loops: sum of voltage rises equals drops; solve for unknown voltages.

concepts.title: Multiloop DC circuit analysis
concepts.description: Solve multiloop circuits by writing and solving simultaneous KCL/KVL equations for branch currents.

concepts.title: Open and short circuits
concepts.description: Diagnose open and short circuits; predict voltage/current in each condition and identify failure symptoms.

concepts.title: Voltage divider rule
concepts.description: Calculate output voltage across a resistor in a series chain using V_out = V_in (R_x / R_total).

concepts.title: Current divider rule
concepts.description: Calculate branch currents in parallel resistors using I_x = I_total (R_total / R_x) or conductance ratios.

concepts.title: Power dissipation in DC circuits
concepts.description: Compute power dissipated by resistors using P=IV=I²R=V²/R and total source power.

concepts.title: Battery internal resistance and terminal voltage
concepts.description: Model real batteries as ideal EMF plus internal resistance; compute terminal voltage under load using V=ε−Ir.

concepts.title: PN junction and depletion region
concepts.description: Describe formation of the depletion region at a PN junction and its role in one-way conduction.

concepts.title: Diode I-V characteristic
concepts.description: Interpret diode I-V curve: forward threshold near 0.7 V for silicon, reverse breakdown, and exponential conduction.

concepts.title: Diode as rectifier
concepts.description: Explain half-wave and bridge rectification converting AC to pulsed DC; identify output waveform.

concepts.title: LEDs and current-limiting resistors
concepts.description: Calculate series resistor for an LED given supply voltage, LED forward voltage, and desired current.

concepts.title: BJT structure and NPN/PNP
concepts.description: Identify base, emitter, collector and majority carrier roles in NPN and PNP bipolar junction transistors.

concepts.title: BJT operating modes and DC biasing
concepts.description: Determine cutoff, active, and saturation modes from junction bias conditions and base drive.

concepts.title: BJT as a switch
concepts.description: Analyze NPN switch operation: base current saturates the transistor to drive loads; calculate required base resistor.

concepts.title: BJT as an amplifier and current gain
concepts.description: Calculate DC current gain β/h_FE and small-signal voltage gain in a basic common-emitter amplifier.

concepts.title: Transistor-level logic gates
concepts.description: Analyze or design ≤2-input NAND/NOR/NOT gates from BJT switching behavior; interpret pull-up/pull-down networks.

concepts.title: Ideal op-amp assumptions
concepts.description: Apply ideal op-amp rules: infinite input impedance, zero output impedance, infinite open-loop gain, virtual short in negative feedback.

concepts.title: Inverting op-amp amplifier
concepts.description: Calculate gain and output voltage for an inverting amplifier using V_out = -(R_f/R_in) V_in.

concepts.title: Non-inverting op-amp amplifier
concepts.description: Calculate gain and output voltage for a non-inverting amplifier using V_out = (1 + R_f/R_g) V_in.

concepts.title: Op-amp comparator
concepts.description: Analyze open-loop op-amp as comparator; determine output saturation high/low based on input voltage comparison.

concepts.title: Op-amp voltage follower/buffer
concepts.description: Analyze voltage follower with unity gain for impedance buffering; explain isolation between stages.

topics.title: Digital logic, Boolean algebra, and timing

concepts.title: Logic gates and truth tables
concepts.description: Interpret AND, OR, NOT, NAND, NOR, XOR, XNOR symbols and truth tables; determine output for given inputs.

concepts.title: Boolean algebra identities and simplification
concepts.description: Apply Boolean algebra laws including identity, null, idempotent, complement, associative, distributive, and absorption to simplify expressions.

concepts.title: De Morgan's laws
concepts.description: Convert between AND/NOR and OR/NAND forms using De Morgan's laws; simplify complemented expressions.

concepts.title: Universal NAND/NOR gate implementation
concepts.description: Implement any basic gate using only NAND or only NOR gates; convert circuit schematics accordingly.

concepts.title: Boolean expression to circuit and circuit to expression
concepts.description: Translate between logic circuit diagrams and Boolean expressions; derive sum-of-products or product-of-sums forms from truth tables.

concepts.title: Combinational circuit synthesis
concepts.description: Design a combinational logic circuit from a verbal specification or truth table, then simplify using Boolean algebra or a Karnaugh map.

concepts.title: XOR and equivalence logic
concepts.description: Analyze XOR/XNOR use in parity, comparison, and arithmetic half-adder circuits.

concepts.title: SR latch from NAND/NOR
concepts.description: Analyze set-reset latch built from cross-coupled NAND/NOR gates; construct state table including invalid or forbidden states.

concepts.title: Clock signals and timing parameters
concepts.description: Define clock period, frequency, duty cycle, rising/falling edges, and setup/hold timing requirements.

concepts.title: Propagation delay and race conditions
concepts.description: Explain gate propagation delay; identify race conditions in asynchronous sequential circuits and glitches.

concepts.title: D and JK flip-flops
concepts.description: Analyze edge-triggered D and JK flip-flop behavior from clock, inputs, and characteristic equations.

concepts.title: Digital timing diagrams
concepts.description: Draw and interpret timing diagrams showing simultaneous gate and sequential outputs over clock cycles.

concepts.title: Breadboard layout and connection
concepts.description: Identify breadboard power rails and terminal strips; wire circuits without unintended shorts and verify continuity.

concepts.title: Multimeter voltage measurement
concepts.description: Measure DC voltage across a component by connecting the multimeter in parallel with correct range and polarity.

concepts.title: Multimeter current measurement
concepts.description: Measure current by breaking the circuit and connecting the multimeter in series; select correct range and respect fuse protection.

concepts.title: Multimeter resistance measurement
concepts.description: Measure resistance with circuit power off; avoid parallel paths; interpret continuity and OL readings.

concepts.title: Mystery resistor via voltage-only method
concepts.description: Determine unknown resistance using a known series resistor and voltage measurements only; apply voltage divider or swap method.

concepts.title: Using DC power supplies safely
concepts.description: Set and limit voltage/current on lab power supplies; interpret displayed output and avoid overloading.

concepts.title: LED circuit balancing and resistor selection
concepts.description: Build and verify LED circuits with current-limiting resistors; measure LED current and adjust for balanced brightness.

concepts.title: USB charger label and power calculation
concepts.description: Interpret USB charger and power adapter labels showing volts and amps; calculate power and energy output.

concepts.title: Building logic from truth table
concepts.description: Given a truth table, construct and wire a logic circuit using available gates on a breadboard and verify outputs.

concepts.title: Circuit troubleshooting with multimeter
concepts.description: Diagnose non-working circuits: check supply voltage, continuity, component orientation, shorts/opens; isolate the faulty section.

concepts.title: 3-way SPDT switch wiring
concepts.description: Wire and analyze two 3-way SPDT switches controlling one load from two locations; verify switch positions.

concepts.title: Equivalent resistance networks measurement
concepts.description: Build or measure series-parallel resistor networks and verify equivalent resistance and voltage/current distribution.
